verdict.rationale: Docs say Cloudflare redacts WHOIS by default and that personal data redaction is free and meets ICANN guidelines. Pricing pages say there are no required add-ons, and a hands-on user confirms transferred domains were redacted without taking any action. Missing for 10: redaction is conditional on the registry permitting it (so some TLDs may not be covered), and no explicit field-level confirmation that name, address and email are each redacted.
